context: Tests entry type selection between ticket kickoff and troubleshooting, and the five kickoff sections.

checklist.name: Chose ticket kickoff for the main request
checklist.description: The agent selects ticket-kickoff.yaml because the user wants to understand the ticket before starting work.

checklist.name: Applied the ambiguity precedence
checklist.description: The agent explains or applies the order Troubleshooting > Ticket Refinement > Ticket Kickoff > Learning > General, or otherwise handles the mixed request deliberately (for example separate entries) rather than silently picking one.

checklist.name: Conditions of Satisfaction section
checklist.description: The entry has `## Conditions of Satisfaction & Acceptance Criteria`.

checklist.name: Open Questions section not blank
checklist.description: `## Open Questions & Gaps` is present and says `None identified` explicitly if nothing is open.

checklist.name: Proof of Work Plan section
checklist.description: The entry has `## Proof of Work Plan`.

checklist.name: Did not rewrite the ticket
checklist.description: The kickoff entry does not contain a proposed ticket description or edit the ticket.

checklist.name: Dated 2026-04-09 and validated
checklist.description: The filename, frontmatter and H1 all use 2026-04-09 and the validator is run.
